tool: Siril decode/extract_Green (camera raw) + astrometry.net solves (solve_field.py --json WCS, evaluated at the frame-center pixel via astropy); epochs from EXIF; consumed by scripts/lib/fingerprint.py
domain_note: camera-raw solves run on the extracted GREEN plane (half-res grid): px figures are green-px at the solve's own scale; the mount verdict rides the scale-free RA rate

_WINDOW_SUBSTITUTED_READ_THIS.what: NOT a standard mount_probe.sh run. Window B is DSC_5192, NOT the DSC_5253 the shipped window rule selects. solve_a below IS the shipped probe's own window A output; solve_b was produced by the identical method on a substituted frame.
_WINDOW_SUBSTITUTED_READ_THIS.why: the shipped rule takes first/last of the longest capture run and is BLIND TO FRAME QUALITY. set-05's run ENDS inside cloud block 4, so window B was DSC_5253 — 96 stars to the extractor, NO SOLUTION blind AND with a 5 deg position hint plus scale hint. The probe therefore cannot complete on this set, and its failure blocked the mount gate (exit 4) and then the route key (exit 5).
_WINDOW_SUBSTITUTED_READ_THIS.substitute: DSC_5192 — the LAST frame of set-05 outside every flagged cloud run (n=517, 1250 stars), solved logodds 207 against window A's 114. Maximises the baseline while staying solvable: 1548 s of the run's 1731 s.
_WINDOW_SUBSTITUTED_READ_THIS.verification: RA 15.0157 deg/hr = 0.9983x sidereal, Dec constant to 37 arcsec, sky separation 4.9012 deg against 4.9102 predicted (0.18%). The other four sets of this session measured the same signature independently.
_WINDOW_SUBSTITUTED_READ_THIS.if_you_re_run_mount_probe.sh: it will overwrite this file and FAIL again — the underlying frame is opaque. Fixing the window rule to prefer a solvable frame is the real repair and is NOT done here (build-path change, owner's call).

window.rule: SUBSTITUTED — see _WINDOW_SUBSTITUTED_READ_THIS. The shipped rule (longest contiguous capture run, first/last) selected DSC_4676 -> DSC_5253; DSC_5253 does not solve.
